title: 第1017章 神域显威第1016章 神域初成初次交锋
lines: “难道…眼前这个人类，与那些狱卒有关？甚至是…狱卒的化身？”
一个可怕的念头在三位魔尊心中升起。
它们不知道的是，林烬所拥有的，何止是与狱卒同源的力量！
他是九狱炎骨血脉的传承者！是地狱熔炉的掌控者！
是幽冥选定的准主宰！
他的存在，对于一切地狱生灵而言，本身就是至高无上的位格压制！
只是此刻的林烬，血脉尚未完全觉醒，力量也未达到巅峰，
这种压制力还处于潜藏的、被动生效的状态，
如同沉睡的巨龙，仅仅是无意识散发的龙威，
便足以让蝼蚁感到不安和力量的流失！
噬魂魔尊一咬牙，冷哼一声说道：
“哼！装神弄鬼！就算与那些讨厌的家伙有些关联又如何？
此地可不是幽冥之地，也不是他们可以制约的地方！”
骨狱魔尊也压下心中的惊疑，暴虐的杀意再次占据上风，
“对！管他与狱卒有何关系！敢窃取吾等地狱本源，就是死罪！
杀了他，吞噬他的力量，或许能窥探到狱卒的秘密！”
“不错！一起上，全力出手！不要给他喘息的机会！”
幽影魔尊阴冷附和，身形再次融入阴影。
“他的灵魂…很美味！我要定了！”
噬魂魔尊尖啸着，无数怨魂面孔同时张开，发出更加恐怖的灵魂尖啸！
三位魔尊不再保留，半步大帝的恐怖威能彻底爆发！
骨狱魔尊的骸骨巨斧燃烧起滔天魔焰，每一击都仿佛能劈开小世界！
幽影魔尊的阴影触手化作无数致命的黑色闪电，从各个维度发起刁钻至极的刺杀！
噬魂魔尊的灵魂尖啸如同实质的黑色波纹，一波接一波地冲击着林烬的识海！
林烬怡然不惧，眼中赤金神光璀璨如星！
幽冥神域全力运转，疯狂吞噬着战场逸散的魔气补充自身！
七尊熔炉轰鸣，镇压四方！
无极神焱与九幽冥火化作两条咆哮的巨龙，
一白一黑，在他周身盘旋飞舞，焚灭万物，蚀魂夺魄！
他脚踏熔炉，身披神火，如同浴火重生的战神，
在三位魔尊狂风暴雨般的围攻中，辗转腾挪，悍然反击！
每一次碰撞，每一次交锋，三位魔尊都清晰地感觉到，
自己的力量在与林烬的熔炉和双火接触时，
都会有一丝极其细微、却难以阻止的流逝！
这种感觉如同附骨之蛆，让它们越来越烦躁，越来越心惊！
content_en:
"Could it be that...the human being in front of me is related to those jailers? Or even...the incarnation of the jailers?"
A terrible thought arose in the hearts of the three Demon Lords.
What they don't know is that Lin Jin possesses more than just the same power as the jailer!
He is the inheritor of the Nine Hell Flame Bone bloodline! He is the controller of the Hell Furnace!
He is the quasi-master chosen by Netherworld!
His existence itself is the supreme personal suppression for all hell creatures!
It's just that at this moment, Lin Jin's bloodline has not yet fully awakened, and his strength has not yet reached its peak.
This repressive force is still latent and passive.
Like a sleeping dragon, it is just the power of the dragon that radiates unconsciously,
It's enough to make the ants feel uneasy and lose their strength!
The Soul-Eating Demon Lord gritted his teeth and snorted coldly:
"Hmph! Pretending to be a ghost! So what if you have some connection with those annoying guys?
This place is not a land of the netherworld, nor is it a place they can control! "
The Bone Hell Demon Lord also suppressed the surprise and doubt in his heart, and his violent killing intent once again took over.
"Yes! No matter what his relationship with the jailer is! Dare to steal the origin of our hell, it is a capital crime!
Kill him, devour his power, and maybe you can get a glimpse of the jailer's secrets! "
"That's right! Let's go together and attack with all our strength! Don't give him a chance to breathe!"
The Shadow Demon Lord echoed coldly, and his figure merged into the shadows again.
"His soul...is delicious! I'm going to order it!"
The Soul-Eating Demon Lord screamed, and countless resentful soul faces opened at the same time, emitting an even more terrifying soul scream!
The three Demon Lords no longer held back, and the terrifying power of the Half-Step Emperor completely exploded!
The giant skeleton ax of the Bone Hell Demon Lord burned with monstrous demonic flames, and every blow seemed to split the small world apart!
The shadow tentacles of the Shadow Demon Lord turned into countless deadly black lightnings, launching extremely cunning assassinations from all dimensions!
The Soul-Eating Demon Lord's soul scream was like a substantial black ripple, impacting Lin Jin's sea of ​​consciousness wave after wave!
"Fight!"
Lin Jin was not afraid, and the red gold light in his eyes was as bright as stars!
The Netherworld God Realm is operating at full strength, frantically devouring the demonic energy escaping from the battlefield to replenish itself!
The seven furnaces roared, suppressing all directions!
Wuji Shenyan and Jiuyou Nether Fire turned into two roaring dragons,
One white and one black, swirling and flying around him, burning everything, consuming souls and souls!
With his feet on the furnace and his body covered with divine fire, he was like the god of war reborn from the ashes.
Under the stormy siege of the three Demon Lords, they tossed and turned and fought back brazenly!
Every collision, every confrontation, the three Demon Lords clearly felt,
When his own power comes into contact with Lin Jing's furnace and twin fires,
There will be an extremely subtle but unstoppable passage!
This feeling is like maggots attached to their bones, making them more and more irritable and frightened!
title_en: Chapter 1017 The Divine Realm Shows Its Power Chapter 1016 The First Confrontation in the Divine Realm
